verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a durable push mechanism: HTTPS webhook posts to up to 10 subscribed URLs per app, scoped by event type, with retries over 3 days and signature verification. The REST overview also references a webhook events catalog. The evidence never names order lifecycle event types (created, updated, fulfilled, canceled), and it doesn't show these webhooks covering agentic-commerce or Store Sync orders; the reverse cart API only covers cart creation and reads. Missing for 10: documented order created/updated/fulfilled/canceled event types, evidence that agent-initiated orders emit these events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
